inventive_nucleus: A thin, high-strength, and low-modulus polymer layer is embedded between the transducer array elements and the imaging electronics to absorb and distribute mechanical stress.
structure: The device consists of a transducer array element, a polymer layer, and an imaging electronics module, arranged in a stacked configuration.
interfaces: transducer array element - polymer layer interface
polymer layer - imaging electronics module interface
materials: imaging electronics module: printed circuit board
control_logic: step1: Measure mechanical stress on the transducer array element
step2: Compare measured stress to threshold value
step3: Activate polymer layer if stress exceeds threshold
interaction: The transducer array element interacts with the polymer layer through mechanical stress, causing the polymer layer to deform and absorb stress.
operating_condition: The device operates under normal environmental conditions, with the polymer layer activated when mechanical stress exceeds a threshold value.
failure_containment: The polymer layer contains failure by absorbing and distributing mechanical stress, reducing the likelihood of transducer array element failure.
expected_effect: The expected effect is a reduction in transducer array element failure rates.
causal_chain: failure: Transducer array element failure
cause: Mechanical stress
intervention: Embedding polymer layer
mechanism: Polymer layer absorbs and distributes mechanical stress
effect: Reduced mechanical stress on transducer array element
response: Reduced transducer array element failure rates
